subject: Settlement timing confirmation + EU VAT routing preference
messages:
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@heliodata.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: AP Team <ap@heliodata.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick: payment timing & VAT docs for Sept invoice

Hi Tessa —

Hope you're well. We're doing a quick reconciliation for HelioData's Sept invoices and wanted to confirm the expected settlement timing for invoice INV-2026-0914. Our AP team prefers an ACH when possible, but for EU entities we sometimes need a wire (or a split remit) to the EU entity to meet VAT reporting.

Could you confirm:
- If Redwood will send an ACH to our US treasury, or a wire directly to our Dublin entity (HelioData EMEA) for this invoice?
- If wire, can you share the beneficiary name exactly as it will appear on the transfer and any VAT registration proof Redwood needs?

I've attached our AP remit preferences for reference. If ACH is easier, we'll accept that but need to reconcile VAT on our side. If a wire, please advise the timeline so we can release goods/close month-end.

Thanks — appreciate a quick note so we can lock the month.

Sanjay Rao
Head of Finance, HelioData
Attachment: heliodata_ap_remit_preferences.csv
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@heliodata.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 11:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick: payment timing & VAT docs for Sept invoice

Thanks Sanjay — looping in Ben from Billing to confirm routing and Monica from Collections for timing. Short answers below, then Ben/Monica can confirm exact beneficiary string and attach our VAT proof.

- Routing: By default we route hosted-customer invoices via ACH to the US treasury. For EU-registered customers that request VAT-aligned settlement, we can send a EUR wire to the EMEA entity.
- For INV-2026-0914 we can do either: ACH to HelioData US (net 30) or wire to HelioData EMEA (earliest next-business-day after authorization).

Ben / Monica: please confirm (1) beneficiary name exactly as it will show on the wire and (2) what VAT documentation Redwood will need from HelioData to support the EU wire (VAT registration copy? WHT forms?).

Tessa
Senior Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Hi Sanjay / Tessa —

Short update from Billing: we can route a EUR wire to HelioData EMEA if you provide the VAT registration and a beneficiary string matching your bank's KYC record. For the beneficiary name, please confirm the exact legal entity (we need it verbatim):

1) HelioData Limited
2) HelioData EMEA Ltd
3) HelioData Ireland Holdings

Please confirm which of the above (or provide the correct legal name). Also let us know whether HelioData prefers the wire reference include the Redwood invoice number (we normally include INV-xxxx to help your reconciliation).

If you can't provide the VAT reg in time, we can still send ACH to the US treasury (expected 2–3 business days for clearing). Wire timeline: we can initiate next business day but beneficiary bank processing can add 1–2 days.

Attachments: sample_wire_template.xlsx (stub)

Thanks,
Ben Carter

Next steps from Redwood:
- We'll initiate a EUR wire to HelioData Limited on Monday (2026-09-20) morning (target value date 2026-09-21).
- Wire reference: "INV-2026-0914 / HelioData Limited" (please confirm if you'd like the invoice number omitted).

If HelioData requires a specific withholding (WHT) certificate from Redwood for EU reporting, please let us know; we can provide a payment trace and a payment confirmation PDF after settlement.

One last ask: can you confirm the earliest time your AP team will process incoming wires (cutoff/timezone) so we can aim for same-day credit on your side?

Thanks — will share tracking once wire is sent.

Monica Patel
